distilled_lessons.remediation: Re-read file with read_file for 5 lines of surrounding context, include function def or enclosing block in old_string.
Never run pytest without explicit file path. Locate test via find tests -name '*test_*.py' and run single file.
Immediately revert changes to test files. Solve root cause in source implementation under src/ or library package.
Do not submit patch without modifying files. Verify git diff before calling submit_patch.
